p-value-tails.alt: Two standard normal curves. Left, labelled one-sided, alternative p < 0.40: the area to the left of the test statistic z = −1.77 is shaded; it is the p-value, about 0.039. Right, labelled two-sided, alternative p is not 0.40: the areas to the left of z = −1.77 and to the right of z = 1.77 are both shaded; together they are the p-value, about 0.077, twice the one-sided value.
